message.text: Looking for the store layer deletion order during memo API deletion.

I will examine the DeleteMemo function in store/memo to identify which related records are deleted before the memo row itself.

I will also check whether dialect-specific implementations perform additional cleanup.

Checking `store/memo.go` to identify which records are deleted before the memo row itself.

`DeleteMemo` removes `memo_relation` rows where the memo is either source or target, plus attachments. Now checking whether attachment deletion cascades to other records, and if reactions or memo shares are also removed.

I am examining the store layer deletion logic for memos to identify which related record types are removed before the memo row itself.

`Store.DeleteMemo` removes `memo_relation` records where the memo is either source or target, plus `attachment` rows. Reactions and `memo_share` do not appear to be deleted by this function.

Tracing the store layer's DeleteMemo logic to identify which related records are removed before the memo row itself.

The store layer deletes memo_relation and attachment records before removing the memo row itself.

Reactions are not deleted at the API or store layer during memo deletion; they are only listed for webhook dispatch.

The store layer deletes memo_relation and attachment records before the memo row itself. This is specified in store/memo.go.
